title: OpenCode arm parity complete
summary: OpenCode arm is at parity with the Claude/Codex adapter contract as of main commit b6e5088. Verified by OpenCode plugin/stub/scheduler tests, harness registry/usage/init tests, diff check, and localhost gate/advisory tests under the required unsandboxed path.
